header: Publishing terms authors ask us to explain

items.definition: A manuscript posted publicly before review. Northstar accepts them from any server and never counts a preprint as prior publication.
The period a dataset stays private after its paper appears. Authors may set up to 24 months, counted from the issue date.
The copy-edited article carrying the DOI. It is the version to cite, and the one that opens to every reader after 12 months.
